title: For spaces finitely presented over a ring, testing against perfect complexes only is enough to detect relative pseudo-coherence
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Improvement of the duality-type characterization: X separated, of finite presentation over a ring A and K in D_QCoh(O_X); if R Gamma(X, E x^L K) is pseudo-coherent in D(A) for every PERFECT E (rather than every pseudo-coherent E), then K is pseudo-coherent relative to A. The retained proof: the hypothesis forces K into D^-_QCoh (Derived Categories of Spaces, detecting-bounded-above), after which every pseudo-coherent E is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded above perfect-by-approximation situation where spaces-perfect-lemma-perfect-enough upgrades the perfect-only test to the full one, closing via the companion characterize-pseudo-coherent lemma. Retained author proof at lines 12239-12248.
